# Completion notification
## Summary
Company owners see one in-app notification per completed application.
## Requirements and acceptance criteria
| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criteria |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | Deliver once | Given company A's completed application, processing the completion event twice creates one notification for company A owners. |
| AC-2 | Tenant boundary | Given an owner only in company B, the completion in A creates no notification for that owner. |
| AC-3 | Retry failure | Given a transient storage failure, retry the same event and create one notification; no success is shown until storage succeeds. |
## Roles and permissions
Owners in the event's company can read their notifications; members and other companies cannot.
## Business rules and edge cases
Uniqueness uses application ID + completion event type. Archived owners receive none. No active owners is a successful no-op. Local examples use A and B fixtures.
## Non-goals
Email, SMS, billing.
